about_the_game:
Brew. Manage. Unwind.

Experience the serene art of hospitality in Beer Onsen Resort, a one‐of‐a‐kind business simulation where you brew beer to infuse into hot springs to serve spirits.

About This Game

Step into a world where bubbling hot springs meet artisanal beer, and wandering spirits seek solace in flavors as much as warmth. As the new Brew Master & Resort Manager, you’ll:

  • Brew Innovative Beer Blends

    • Experiment with hops, grains, spices—and even mystical botanicals—to craft signature elixirs.

    • Infuse each blend directly into your hot springs, customizing aroma, color, and potency to delight every spectral guest.

    Unlock & Master Recipes

    • Discover age-old classics from across the spirit realm, as well as playful, offbeat concoctions like Tropical Storm IPA and Wild Grape Lager.

  • Embrace Emergent, Chill Gameplay

    • Relax at your own pace.

    • Watch spirits react uniquely: some crave bold flavors, others subtle notes—learn their preferences and watch words spread through the misty land.

Key Features

  • Deep Brewing System Intuitive drag-and-drop interface meets layered crafting—every tweak to your recipe yields measurable changes in guest satisfaction.

  • Character-Driven Economy Each spirit has a story and a palate—cater to their tastes for tips, special orders, or rare ingredients as rewards.

  • Arcade-Light Management Casual but engaging: streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, or dive deep into fine-tuning.

  • Relaxing Soundscape & Art Style A lush, hand-crafted world, accompanied by a calming soundtrack that evolves with your resort’s growth.

Are you ready to craft the ultimate haven for weary souls? Build your legacy—one brew, one soak, and one satisfied spirit at a time.

short_description: Welcome to Beer Onsen Resort! As both Brew Master and Resort Manager, you’ll concoct extraordinary brews, infuse them into steaming hot springs, and pamper wandering spirits from every corner. Rack up gold, unlock arcane recipes, and turn this retreat into the spirit realm’s hottest getaway!
